name: 77571 · La Porte, TX
findings: ZIP 77571 (La Porte) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77571 (La Porte) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77571 (La Porte) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 25% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.
